title: On Monogeneity of reciprocal polynomials
summary: Let $\mathbb{Z}_K$ denote the ring of integers of the number field $K = \mathbb{Q}(θ)$, where $θ$ is a root of the monic irreducible polynomial $f(x) \in \mathbb{Z}[x]$. We say that $f(x)$ is monogenic if $\mathbb{Z}_K = \mathbb{Z}[θ]$. A polynomial $f(x) \in \mathbb{Z}[x]$ is called reciprocal if $f(x) = x^{\operatorname{deg}(f)} f(1/x)$. In this article, we derive sufficient conditions for the monogeneity of even degree reciprocal polynomials.
